svg.title: Steps or cost: how the two searches spread
svg.desc: An animation on a grid of 8 by 6 intersections with (0, 0) at the bottom-left, bigger than the floor grid so the shape shows. A wall of four blocked intersections stands at x = 3 from y = 1 to y = 4, so the only ways past it are the gap along the top row, where the two blocks either side of x = 3 are a slow road costing 5 each, and the gap along the bottom row. S is (0, 4) and D is (7, 4). Two buttons. BFS: each intersection lights up with its step count, the ripple spreads evenly and crosses the slow road as if it were normal, and the path goes over the top: 9 steps, cost 17. Dijkstra: each intersection lights up with its cheapest cost when it is finished; the wave races along the bottom but crawls through the slow road, and reaches D first from below, so the path goes around the bottom: 15 steps, cost 15.
svg.text: Steps or cost: how the two searches spread
